summary.text: Bill Schuette is a Republican state representative from Michigan House of Representatives District 95 who has served since January 1, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat AnnMarie Horseman.

paragraphs.text: Bill Schuette graduated from Dow High School and earned a B.S. and an M.A. from Georgetown University.
His career experience includes working as an intelligence officer with the Defense Intelligence Agency and in public policy with Dow Inc.
Ballotpedia lists affiliations with the NRA, Right to Life of Michigan, the Michigan Farm Bureau and the Midland Business Alliance.
Schuette served on the House Appropriations Committee in 2023 and 2024.

In 2025 and 2026 his assignments include the Financial Services, Judiciary and Insurance committees, and he chairs both the Rules and Competitiveness Committee and the Select Committee on Protecting Michigan Employees and Small Businesses.
